Second, it corrected the maintenance question I posed: this cycle added ZERO copies, because cycle 1's comment already carried the literal — the real cost is a dropped 'build.go rule 6' cross-reference, one parenthetical. Delta exactly 5 files, +39/-12. Cumulative 78 files, net -724, INSIDE the declared [-250,-750] band; the file count against the <=60 cap was already accepted.
